text: I think you'll really enjoy this Chili Chicken recipe! As a fan of chicken, you'll appreciate the 28g of protein it packs per serving, which aligns perfectly with your health goal. The dish is also gluten-free, meeting your dietary constraint. The combination of flavors from the fish sauce, sweet chili sauce, and coriander will add a nice depth to the dish without requiring any gluten-containing ingredients. With a cooking time of under 30 minutes, it fits within your time budget, making it a great option for a quick and satisfying meal.
